BiblicalUsage: Zaram is water pouring out in a flood, the clouds emptying themselves in a storm. The Psalmist remembers the waters at the Red Sea pouring down as God led His people through, and in Psalm 90 the same flood becomes a picture of how quickly our years are carried away.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe our lives pass like floodwater, and only God stands steady while the years rush past.
